---
title: "model_comp"
output: html_document
---

This markdown runs model comparison on fitted PBA against WBA for each scenerio. It uses Pareto-Smoothed Importance Sampling (PSIS) to approximate the out-of-sample performance by approximating the expected log pointwise predictive density (ELPD).

```{r}
pacman::p_load(cmdstanr, tidyverse, tidybayes, loo)
```


```{r}
scenario_folders <- list.files("scenario_data", full.names = T)

scenario_counter = 1
#loop through scenarios

#setup empty output list
model_comparison_list <- list()

#loop through each scenario folder
for (scenario in scenario_folders) {

  #get scenario data
  data_file = list.files(scenario, full.names = T, pattern = "*.csv")

  #get models
  rds_files <- list.files(scenario, full.names = T, pattern = "*.rds")

  #store empty list for loos
  loo_objects = list()

    #compute loo for each model
  for (model_file in rds_files) {

    #read in fit
    fit <- readRDS(model_file)

    cat(model_file, "\n")

    #make loo
    loo_obj <- fit$loo()

    #assign to correct var name
    if (str_detect(model_file, "pba")){
      pba_loo <- loo_obj
    } else{
      wba_loo <- loo_obj
    }

  }
  #put objects into named list. Important for naming output in loo_compare. Then compare
  loo_list = list(PBA = pba_loo,
                WBA = wba_loo)

  #make loo comparison and get model weights
  loo_comparison <- loo_compare(loo_list)
  model_weights <- loo_model_weights(loo_list)

  #store both in as named in list under each scenario
  model_comparison_list[[scenario_counter]] <- list(
    scenario      = basename(scenario),
    loo_comparison = loo_comparison,
    model_weights  = model_weights,
    pba_loo        = pba_loo,
    wba_loo        = wba_loo
  )

  #id for scenarios
  scenario_counter = scenario_counter + 1


}
```

```{r results='asis'}
all_plot_df    <- list()
all_weights_df <- list()

for (res in model_comparison_list) {
  scenario_label <- paste("Scenario", res$scenario)

  cat("##", scenario_label, "\n\n")

  # --- Table: ELPD diff, SE diff, stacking weights ---
  comp_mat <- res$loo_comparison
  weights  <- res$model_weights

  table_df <- data.frame(
    Model           = rownames(comp_mat),
    ELPD_diff       = round(comp_mat[, "elpd_diff"], 2),
    SE_diff         = round(comp_mat[, "se_diff"],   2),
    Stacking_weight = round(as.numeric(weights[rownames(comp_mat)]), 3)
  )

  print(knitr::kable(table_df, row.names = FALSE,
                     col.names = c("Model", "ELPD diff", "SE diff", "Stacking weight"),
                     caption = paste(scenario_label, "- LOO comparison")))
  cat("\n\n")

  all_plot_df[[res$scenario]] <- data.frame(
    Scenario  = scenario_label,
    Model     = rownames(comp_mat),
    elpd_diff = comp_mat[, "elpd_diff"],
    se_diff   = comp_mat[, "se_diff"]
  )

  all_weights_df[[res$scenario]] <- data.frame(
    Scenario        = scenario_label,
    Model           = names(weights),
    Stacking_weight = as.numeric(weights)
  )
}
```


## Simulated scenarios

```{r}
scenario_plot_df    <- bind_rows(all_plot_df[names(all_plot_df) != "real_data"])
scenario_weights_df <- bind_rows(all_weights_df[names(all_weights_df) != "real_data"])

scenario_weights_long <- scenario_weights_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Stacking_weight) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PBA, WBA), names_to = "Model", values_to = "Stacking_weight")

ggplot(scenario_weights_long, aes(x = reorder(Scenario, as.integer(gsub("Scenario ", "", Scenario))), y = Stacking_weight, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Scenario", y = "Stacking weight") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot(scenario_plot_df, aes(x = Model, y = elpd_diff, color = Model)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = elpd_diff - se_diff, ymax = elpd_diff + se_diff), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ Scenario) +
  labs(y = "ELPD diff", x = "Model") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

scenario_loser_df <- scenario_plot_df %>%
  filter(elpd_diff != 0) %>%
  mutate(winner = ifelse(Model == "PBA", "WBA", "PBA"))

ggplot(scenario_loser_df, aes(x = reorder(Scenario, as.integer(gsub("Scenario ", "", Scenario))), y = elpd_diff)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = winner)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = elpd_diff - se_diff, ymax = elpd_diff + se_diff), width = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  labs(x = "Scenario", y = "ELPD Diff", fill = "Worse Model") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```



```{r}
problematic_ids <- pareto_k_ids(pba_loo) 

pareto_k_vals <- pareto_k_values(pba_loo)

scen_3 <- read_csv("scenario_data/3/scenario_3.csv")

scen_3 <- scen_3 %>% 
  mutate(problematic_pareto = trial_id %in% problematic_ids)

scen_3$pareto_k_vals <- pareto_k_vals


ggplot(scen_3, aes(x = first_ratings, y = group_ratings, color = if_else(pareto_k_vals == Inf, T, F))) +
  geom_jitter(width = .15, height = .15) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(scen_3, aes(x = first_ratings, y = group_ratings, color = problematic_pareto)) +
    geom_jitter(width = .15, height = .15) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal()


```
